items.title: Crypto never closes, but Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP and Solana now move on Wall Street time
items.whyYouShouldCare: The synchronization of crypto trading with Wall Street hours may enhance institutional participation in Solana, impacting liquidity and market dynamics.

items.title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
items.whyYouShouldCare: The issuance of 263K tokens in one day indicates heightened activity in the Solana ecosystem, which could attract more developers and users.

items.title: Crypto hack: Blockstream rejects ransom as nearly 600 Bitcoin remains missing
items.whyYouShouldCare: The unresolved hack involving Bitcoin highlights ongoing security risks in the crypto space, which could affect investor confidence across all networks, including Solana.
